title: AITask now lives in ai/; the rule for what goes there is written down

owner_note.text: I moved AITask from ext/ to ai/ by script, and the old address now points to the new one. The rule is at the top of the ai and ext readmes: a module that exists only to run, show or feed an AI goes in ai/, and one that any page could use stays in ext/, ux/ or core/. Dictate stays in ux/ for now: moving it, and the other modules of the AI group, is a proposal in the doc linked below, not done. Of the two session sets, ai/AISession is the live one; the old ai/sessions/Session*.js files are only forwarding stubs and are proposed for retirement.
